hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For focused questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md) instead of grepping raw files. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture context."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For codebase questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than reading files one by one), `graphify explain \"<concept>\"`, or `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"`, instead of reading source files to answer. Read raw files to modify or debug specific code, or when the graph lacks the detail."}}'; fi || true

IN=$(cat); F=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$F" in *.swift) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('session_id',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$SID" ] && touch "/tmp/qp-dirty-$SID"; SL=$(command -v swiftlint || echo /opt/homebrew/bin/swiftlint); [ -x "$SL" ] || exit 0; ERR=$(cd macos && "$SL" lint --quiet "$F" 2>&1 | grep ': error:' | head -10); if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then echo "$ERR" >&2; exit 2; fi

IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('session_id',''))" 2>/dev/null); SENT="/tmp/qp-dirty-$SID"; CNT="/tmp/qp-attempts-$SID"; [ -n "$SID" ] && [ -f "$SENT" ] || exit 0; N=$(cat "$CNT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); case "$N" in ''|*[!0-9]*) N=0;; esac; if [ "$N" -ge 5 ]; then echo "Verification still failing after 5 attempts; allowing stop. Report what remains unfixed." >&2; rm -f "$SENT" "$CNT"; exit 0; fi; set -o pipefail; OUT=$(cd macos && xcodebuild test -scheme QuickProtect -destination 'platform=macOS' -quiet 2>&1 | tail -40); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo $((N+1)) > "$CNT"; echo "$OUT" >&2; echo "[gate attempt $((N+1))/5 failed: tests] Fix the cause, then stop again to re-verify." >&2; exit 2; fi; SL=$(command -v swiftlint || echo /opt/homebrew/bin/swiftlint); if [ -x "$SL" ]; then LOUT=$(cd macos && "$SL" lint --strict --quiet 2>&1 | tail -20); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo $((N+1)) > "$CNT"; echo "$LOUT" >&2; echo "[gate attempt $((N+1))/5 failed: swiftlint --strict] Fix the cause, then stop again to re-verify." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; rm -f "$SENT" "$CNT"
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying QuickProtect (tests + strict lint) before stopping…
